title: thalictrum minus var. foetidum
intro: Thalictrum minus var. foetidum, commonly known as Foetid Meadow Rue, is a plant species within the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Foetid Meadow Rue include treating skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, as well as reducing inflammation and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
